descriptions.preferred: 'Enkan' is a dwarf red strap-leaved maple from Japan, brought back to Europe in 1991 by Cor van Gelderen of earilobums. The medium-sized five-lobed leaves are divided almost to the base and are slightly broader than long, 7-8 cm long and 9-10 cm wide. The smaller basal lobes are almost at right angles to the petioles. In the mature leaf, the lobes are straplike with bluntly pointed or rounded tips, untoothed or barely toothed, and 2-4 mm wide. The lobes of leaves from vigorous young shoots are finely and sharply toothed, up to 1 cm wide in the middle, and lanceolate-ovate with pointed tips. The purple-red petioles are 2. 5-3. 5 cm long. sources.title: 燕焕 Acer Palmatum 'Enkan'
sources.description: "燕焕"由日本培育，其树形矮小，叶片为红色的线形叶。 1991年荷兰Firma C. Esveld公司的Cor van Gelderen引进欧洲 ， 有时也称为 " Aekan les " 。 它与另一个杰出的线叶品种 " 红色霹雳 （Red Pygmy）"非常相似，该品种同样由Firma C. Esveld公司发布。 不过，"燕焕"的酒红色叶片在各种环境下表现都更为出色，即使在酷热的气候下也有不错的表现。 它是线叶群中颜色最深的红色叶品种。 其叶片中等， 通常为 5裂，叶裂几乎深基部 。 春天是酒红色，夏季会适当返绿，秋天是明亮的大红色。 "燕焕"树形直立，株高可达3米，但冠幅不及3米，习性与绿色叶的"琴之系（Koto no ito）"相似 。

rhs.description: A small, upright, slow-growing tree ultimately to about 2m tall and 1. 5m across. The wine-red leaves have five long, narrow, smooth-edged leaflets, and turn bright red in autumn. Inconspicuous green flowers in spring are followed by red and green, winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Enkan' 是来自日本的一种矮性红叶细带叶槭，1991 年由 Cor van Gelderen 从日本带回欧洲。 其叶片中等大小，5 裂，几乎深裂至叶基，长度略小于宽度，叶长 7-8 厘米、宽 9-10 厘米。 较小的基部裂片与叶柄近乎成直角。 成熟叶的裂片呈带状，先端钝尖或圆钝，边缘无齿或近无齿，宽 2-4 毫米。 强旺幼枝上的叶片裂片则具细密而尖锐的锯齿，中部最宽可达 1 厘米，形状为披针状卵形，先端尖。 紫红色叶柄长 2. 5-3. 5 厘米。 'Enkan' 可形成直立树形，高可达 3 米，冠幅较窄，树姿与 'Koto-no-ito' 相似。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、直立、生长缓慢的树木，最终高约 2 米、冠幅约 1. 5 米。 酒红色叶片具 5 枚细长、狭窄、边缘平滑的裂片，秋季转为鲜红色。 春季开不显眼的绿色小花，秋季随后结红绿色翅果。
